title: Burnished Ring
summary: Use an Action once per Long Rest to fire Paralyzing Ray at a creature up to 60 ft away. It makes a Constitution save against your spell save DC or is Paralysed for 2 turns.

fields.Effect: Use an Action once per Long Rest to fire Paralyzing Ray at a creature up to 60 ft away. It makes a Constitution save against your spell save DC or is Paralysed for 2 turns.
